subject: [PATCH v4 01/11] mm, swap: add virtual swap device infrastructure

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch introduces the virtual swap device infrastructure, which allows for dynamic allocation of swap space and enables features like zswap and zero-filled pages without a physical swap device. The virtual swap device is created when the 'vswap' kernel parameter is set to 'on', and it lives for the lifetime of the kernel. The patch also includes changes to various files such as mm/swap.h, mm/page_io.c, and mm/vswap.h to support this new infrastructure. The dynamic-cluster allocator is wired in, but no allocation path can select it yet, with subsequent patches expected to add the necessary paths.
